output_text:
name: php-mcp-server-generator
description: Generate a complete production-ready PHP MCP server using the official PHP SDK.
Ask for: project name; server description; transport (stdio, http, or both); tools; resources/prompts; PHP version (8.2+ required).
Composer: `"name": "your-org/{project-name}"`, `"description": "{Server description}"`, `"optimize-autoloader": true`, `"preferred-install": "dist"`, `"sort-packages": true`.
PHP 8.2 or higher
Use PHP Attributes: `#[McpTool]`, `#[McpResource]`, `#[McpPrompt]`; strict types (`declare(strict_types=1);`) in all files; PSR-12; `#[Schema]` validation; specific exceptions with clear messages; PHPUnit tests for all tools; PHPDoc for all methods; Always use PSR-16 cache for discovery in production.
Use `require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';`, `Mcp\Server`, `StdioTransport`, `FilesystemAdapter`, `Psr16Cache`; cache `mcp-discovery` at `__DIR__ . '/cache'`; excludeDirs: `['vendor', 'tests', 'cache']`; server version `1.0.0`.
Include greeting, arithmetic, configuration resource `config://app/settings`, template `data://{category}/{id}`, code-review and documentation prompts; examples `simpleAction`, `validateEmail`, `Status`, `setStatus`, `getSettings`, `getUser`.
Tests include greet, add, divide, division-by-zero and invalid-operation cases; PHPUnit XML uses `vendor/autoload.php`, directories `tests` and `src`.
php server.ph
